strategies.text: Offer the smallest realistic instalment and let them name what they can manage — do not push a figure they'll break.
Re-establish contact and safety before money — acknowledge the situation, then ask one gentle affordability question.
State the next consequence plainly and calmly, then offer a clear way to avoid it today.
This is friction, not inability — offer to set up the payment right now on the call and get one confirmation.
Acknowledge the dispute, log it, and separate the disputed portion from what is not in question so a partial payment can still move.
Do not argue the amount — walk through income and essential outgoings so the plan is one they can actually service.
A vague 'I'll call back' rarely converts — offer a specific short window and confirm a callback time before ending.
